policy_status: Paired x86 cohort; pillow-rs CPU/SIMD correctness is gated against regular Pillow 12.1.1. Pillow-SIMD timings are compared only where its outputs also match regular Pillow.
notes: This x86-only cohort compares pillow-rs CPU/SIMD, ordinary Pillow 12.1.1, and Pillow-SIMD 12.1.1.post0 on identical workloads and measurement policies.

Pillow-SIMD and Pillow were run in separate virtual environments because both install the PIL namespace. pillow-rs CPU/SIMD parity uses regular Pillow; Pillow-SIMD compatibility is checked separately and incompatible baseline cells remain visible with their speed ratios withheld.

The matched cohort covers 34 full-size, parity-backed individual-operation cases: all 29 current pipeline-op cases, the established RGB GaussianBlur case, and getchannel in L, LA, RGB, and RGBA. Every workload uses identical inputs and measurement policy across the three sources.
This cohort uses the Pillow-SIMD default SSE4 build. It is not comparable with the Apple ARM measurements on the main benchmark page.

Pillow-SIMD output differed from regular Pillow on 2 workload(s); those baseline cells are retained and no Pillow-SIMD speed ratio is accepted: pipeline-op.filter.material-l-noise-5x5-1024x768, pipeline-op.grayscale.material-rgb-noise-1024x768.
